scope.description: Bounded audit of main-series automatic and battle form transitions, with existing-Zygarde reassembly. Generic Mega/Gigantamax/Primal, Necrozma fusion, GO-specific mechanics, Contests and other spin-offs are outside this manifest.
scope.gameCoverage: Explicit games identify researched subsets or version-dependent rules. Missing games mean unknown; this is not an exhaustive title matrix.
scope.conditionSemantics: Conditions within a method are AND. Entries in method.from, battle_event.events, weather.weather and other listed alternatives are OR. original_form is the individual form before a temporary transformation; intrinsic_form is persistent identity such as Minior core color.

citations.section: Form data and introductory form description

notes: Three weather forms allow transitions from every other Castform form. Forecast and effective weather are both required.
Generation V onward ability-loss reversion is separate from the Generations III/IV retained-form behavior.
gaps: Contests are described by the source but not modeled by this battle-focused manifest.
Complete supported-game enumeration is not established; omitted games are unknown.
Snow is an upstream mechanic description; no unsupported game or GO transformation route is inferred.

citations.section: Form data and introductory form description

notes: Generation IV form changes are independent of Flower Gift; later ability-driven behavior is separate.
Legends: Arceus requires battle, daylight, and sunny/harsh-sunlight overworld weather.
gaps: Contest transformations are outside scope.
Complete per-game coverage and Flower Gift suppression edge cases beyond the documented general rule remain unaudited.

citations.section: Form data and introductory form description

citations.support: End-of-turn thresholds, switch-out reversion, and Generation V/VI suppression.

notes: Unovan and Galarian transitions are independent pairs with no cross-regional edges.
Both directions use end-of-turn HP checks; switch-out restores each regional Standard Mode.
gaps: GO mechanics and complete title coverage are outside this bounded main-series audit.

citations.section: Form data and introductory form description

citations.support: Relic Song needs to affect a target; Sheer Force removes the transformation effect.

notes: Relic Song toggles both directions only when it affects a target and its additional effects have not been removed by Sheer Force.
Withdraw/battle end restores Aria.
gaps: Contest Spectaculars and Mystery Dungeon form selection are excluded.
Per-game coverage omitted rather than inferred from distribution or availability.

citations.section: Form data and introductory form description

notes: Blade/Shield move transitions happen before moves; Legends: Z-A rules are separately scoped and omit Ability requirements.
gaps: GO battle-only form mechanics are not researched here.
Exact Legends: Z-A animation timing is explanatory text, not a simulation clock.

citations.section: Form data and introductory form description

notes: Neutral/Active is cosmetic battle presentation.
Cached source explicitly says GO and Legends: Z-A have no distinct programmed forms; do not infer those routes from generic methods.
gaps: Contests and mobile HOME summary presentation excluded.
Generic methods intentionally omit games; this does not assert GO or Legends: Z-A support.

citations.section: Form data and introductory form description

citations.support: Dedicated Ability effect establishes <=50% end-of-turn trigger and original-form reversion, including Legends: Z-A differences.
Independent AbilityDex game text corroborates half HP or less.
Independent check of 10/50/100-cell assembly and destructive separation.
Generation VII Power Construct restriction, Generation VIII form switching, Legends: Z-A item presence.

notes: Power Construct uses <=50% HP. The cached species prose and Serebii general forms page say below half; dedicated Bulbapedia Ability effect and Serebii AbilityDex game text say half or less. The dedicated mechanic references take precedence.
Original-form guard prevents Complete from reverting to the wrong 10%/50% identity.
Generation VII Cube switching requires Power Construct; Sword/Shield switching does not.
Reassembly Unit route models upgrading an existing 10% individual; collecting Cells from scratch is acquisition, not a transition from an existing Pokémon form.
gaps: Cells/Cores are not dataset Pokémon records, so creating a new 10%/50% Zygarde solely from Cells cannot be represented by from/sources Pokémon IDs.
Separating an Aura Break Zygarde destroys that individual; later recreation is not encoded as a direct reversible form edge.
Power Construct ability-only changes on unchanged 50% form are not form transitions.
GO Cell-based form changes are outside this main-series scope.
Mega Zygarde is delegated outside this manifest.

citations.section: Form data and introductory form description

notes: School Form requires level 20 and HP >25%; the reversion threshold includes exactly 25%.
Entry and end-of-turn checks are distinct from switch-out/battle-end reset.
gaps: Game enumeration is unknown rather than inherited from saved availability.

citations.section: Form data and introductory form description

citations.support: Exact <=50% core and >50% meteor thresholds and entry/end-of-turn timing.
Independent confirmation that core colors are fixed and cannot be changed.
Dedicated AbilityDex used as secondary threshold reference.

notes: All seven cores use intrinsic_form, preserving fixed core color through the single collapsed Meteor record.
The dedicated Shields Down page resolves exact-half wording: core at <=50%, Meteor above 50%.
Caught Minior return to their own core outside battle; wild overworld Meteor presentation is not a player-selectable color transition.
gaps: SV internally distinguishes Meteor colors, while the dataset has one Meteor record; intrinsic_form carries that lost identity.
GO and complete title enumeration are outside scope.

citations.section: Form data and introductory form description

citations.support: Secondary AbilityDex reference for disguise breaking.

notes: Damaging hit and confusion self-hit routes are separate. Ability-ignoring attacks do not break Disguise.
Faint/battle-end restores Disguised; merely switching does not.
Legends: Z-A preserves the transformation without Abilities.
gaps: HP damage differences before/after Generation VIII are not a form condition.
GO form mechanics and move-by-move Ability bypass enumeration are excluded.

citations.section: Form data and introductory form description

citations.support: Surf must deal damage, Dive does not; switch-out and Dynamax resets; losing the Ability freezes the caught-prey form.

notes: Surf and Dive are separate alternatives; Surf must deal damage.
Gulping uses >50% HP; Gorging includes exactly 50%.
Prey is discarded on recall/battle end or Dynamax. Getting hit requires Gulp Missile still be present.
gaps: GO Gulp Missile added in 2026 has different mechanics and was not included in this main-series audit.
Version-specific Ability-copy restrictions are not modeled; the active-Ability requirement preserves the current form rule.

citations.section: Form data and introductory form description

citations.support: Ice restoration requires hail/snow beginning or switch-in; Noice survives switch-out.
Secondary AbilityDex reference for physical-hit and weather mechanic.

notes: Noice remains through switch-out.
Restoration requires entering hail/snow or that weather newly beginning; continuing weather alone is insufficient.
gaps: Exact per-title weather lists are not enumerated; hail/snow are alternative documented mechanics.
Move-by-move Ice Face bypass and confusion interactions are not exhaustively encoded.

citations.section: Form data and introductory form description

citations.support: Terastallization prevents form switching; Legends: Z-A uses Aura Wheel.

notes: Hunger Switch toggles after turns and is prevented by Terastallization.
Legends: Z-A toggles after Aura Wheel without an Ability.
Terastallized Hangry does not reset merely from switching.
gaps: GO Charged Attack switching is excluded from this bounded main-series manifest.
Detailed Ability replacement/suppression exceptions remain outside form-transition scope.

citations.section: Form data and introductory form description

notes: Must switch out alive; Hero then remains until battle end.
Only Scarlet/Violet scope is asserted.

citations.section: Form data and introductory form description

citations.support: Terastal lasts until battle end and also appears in auto battles.

notes: Entry activates Tera Shift; Terastallization changes Terastal to Stellar.
Battle-end reset covers both transformed states, with no incorrect Normal reversion on switch/faint.
gaps: Stellar-to-Terastal behavior if Terastallization ends on fainting is not asserted without specific evidence.
Auto Battle animation transitions are documented upstream but excluded from ordinary battle-event modeling.

citations.section: Form data and introductory form description

notes: Generation VII Battle Bond alone enables Ash-Greninja; Scarlet/Violet uses a different Ability effect.
The source must directly defeat an opponent while battle continues; reversion on faint prevents retriggering that battle.
The ordinary Greninja record collapses the nonbreeding male Battle Bond identity; Ability condition and note retain this distinction.
gaps: No separate Battle Bond base record exists.
Mega Greninja is handled outside this manifest.

citations.section: Form data and introductory form description

notes: Only fused Dusk Mane/Dawn Wings can Ultra Burst while holding Ultranecrozium Z.
Original-form guard restores the same fusion on faint or battle end; no invented unfused Necrozma edge.
gaps: Fusion/separation into Dusk Mane/Dawn Wings is handled outside this manifest.

rareConditionDefinitions.weather_effects_active: The present weather has not been negated by an active weather-negating Ability.
rareConditionDefinitions.weather_effects_negated: Current weather is negated by Cloud Nine, Air Lock, or the corresponding weather-negating mechanic.
rareConditionDefinitions.forecast_suppressed_or_replaced: Forecast is suppressed or has been replaced by another Ability.
rareConditionDefinitions.sunlight_effect_or_flower_gift_inactive: The effective sunlight or active Flower Gift required for Sunshine Form has ceased.
rareConditionDefinitions.in_battle: The individual is currently participating in a battle.
rareConditionDefinitions.legends_arceus_sunshine_conditions_ended: Outside battle, at night, or overworld weather is neither sunny nor harsh sunlight.
rareConditionDefinitions.zen_mode_suppressed_or_replaced: Zen Mode is suppressed or replaced in Generations V/VI.
rareConditionDefinitions.move_affects_at_least_one_target: The specified move succeeds in affecting at least one target.
rareConditionDefinitions.ability_is_not_sheer_force: Meloetta does not currently have Sheer Force removing Relic Song's additional effect.
rareConditionDefinitions.at_least_40_additional_zygarde_cells: The Cube contains at least 40 Cells/Cores in addition to those in the source 10% Zygarde.
rareConditionDefinitions.disguise_not_bypassed: The incoming attack does not ignore Disguise through its move effect or the attacker's Ability.
rareConditionDefinitions.move_deals_damage: The specified move successfully deals damage.
rareConditionDefinitions.ice_face_not_bypassed: The incoming physical move does not bypass Ice Face.
rareConditionDefinitions.hail_or_snow_begins: Hail or snow newly begins while Eiscue is on the field.
rareConditionDefinitions.directly_knock_out_opponent: Greninja directly causes an opposing Pokemon to faint through its attack.
rareConditionDefinitions.battle_continues: The knockout does not end the battle.
rareConditionDefinitions.battle_bond_not_previously_used: Battle Bond has not already activated for this individual during this battle.
rareConditionDefinitions.ultra_burst_unused_by_trainer: The trainer has not already used Ultra Burst in this battle.
